[github_combined_reference.pdf p.13] Example curl -L -X POST -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2025-06-01" \ https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/releases \ -d '{"tag_name":"v2.0.0","make_latest":"true","generate_release_notes":true}' Returns 201 Created. There was also no make_latest control — whether a release showed as “Latest” was determined purely by an internal heuristic based on publish date and prerelease/draft status, which occasionally marked an older release as “Latest” if a newer one was still in draft. 13
